run_ncut_normalized_cut: run normalized cut on feature maps to detect object bipartitions and predict bounding boxes
run_detect_box: run detect_box to extract a bounding box from a bipartition mask and seed index
run_get_feats: run get_feats to extract key features from a transformer QKV output tensor
run_GMM_partition: run GMM to partition eigenvectors into two clusters using a Gaussian Mixture Model
run_Kmeans_partition: run Kmeans_partition to cluster eigenvectors into two groups using K-Means with two clusters
